name: PUT mapping with duplicate dynamic template names emits a warning

headers.warning: 299 Elasticsearch-9.6.0-fb6c326106bd340b4701a071e59b36dc30be829e "Dynamic template [my_template] in index [test_dup_templates] is defined more than once.
